Caline Caline CP-xx series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal events 2017 Musikmesse Frankfurt 2017 Caline CP-34 Headroom - Vintage Distortion Published on April 11, 2017 Caline CP-xx series distortion pedal Musikmesse Frankfurt 2017 Musikmesse 2017 Musikmesse 2017 Information The Caline CP-34 Head Room Vintage Distortion is a compact analog distortion pedal that delivers medium to high gain tones with a voicing associated with RAT-style circuits. It is designed to cover a range of classic rock and higher gain textures, with a tonal character that can extend from focused distortion to more saturated, fuzz-like sounds. The circuit emphasizes a pronounced bite and low-end weight, making it suitable for both rhythm and lead applications. The pedal features a three-mode selector switch labeled Normal, Turbo, and Solo, which alters the clipping and frequency response. These modes provide variations in gain structure and tonal emphasis, allowing different levels of saturation and frequency shaping while retaining the core distortion character. The mode switch interacts with the primary controls to expand the available tonal range. A three-knob control layout provides adjustment over output level, gain, and tonal brightness. The Dist control sets the amount of distortion, while the Volume control adjusts the overall output level. The Filter control functions as a tone-shaping filter that adjusts brightness, operating similarly to a combined high-pass and low-pass response depending on its position, enabling both darker and brighter tonal settings. The CP-34 uses a true bypass switching system to preserve the unprocessed signal when disengaged. It is housed in a compact aluminum alloy enclosure and supports standard 9 V DC center-negative power or battery operation. Controls Volume : Adjusts the overall output level of the pedal Dist : Controls the amount of distortion gain Filter : Adjusts tonal brightness, functioning as a variable filter Mode switch (Normal / Turbo / Solo) : Selects between three clipping and frequency response variations Connections Input : 6.35 mm (1/4 inch) mono input jack Output : 6.35 mm (1/4 inch) mono output jack Power : 9 V DC center-negative adapter input or battery connection Technical Specifications Input impedance
